lane: the brief's single method paragraph, second disagreement case: 'Where B is confident and A is not, suspect surface artifacts such as roads or erosion lines'

prior_belief_disclosed.source: evidence/h97_channel_screen.json (H97 screening; PROXY-INSTRUMENT attribution, explicitly not promotable)
prior_belief_disclosed.instrument: gems52-offcatalogue-prevalence-matched-v1 (SGMC faults >= 300 m from labels, thinned to 14089 px), K = 37654, spacing 3 px, 200 m ring
prior_belief_disclosed.why_a_new_round_is_required: post-hoc arm selection is forbidden in this repository (registry/h82_preregistration.json attribution_arms_not_promotable; AGENTS.md). The arm is therefore frozen here as H98's primary BEFORE any H98 fit, with the screening named as the prior belief and the validation carried out on a DIFFERENT instrument.
prior_belief_disclosed.conflict_flagged: the measured result is the opposite of the brief's stated prior for this case. Both are recorded; neither is deleted. The lane pre-check decides whether a file may ship at all.

view_definitions_frozen.A: bands 18, 11, 5, 3, 9, 2: percentile-rank of the Gaussian gradient magnitude at sigma 2 px, equal weights (identical to H97, no tuning)
view_definitions_frozen.B: band 12 detrended elevation curvature magnitude at sigma 2 and 6 px, band 12 gradient magnitude sigma 2, band 19 detrended-slope curvature sigma 2, band 6 in-stack radiometric total count smoothed sigma 4; equal weights (identical to H97)

lane_precheck_rule.order: the lane and uniqueness gates run FIRST, on the exact support that would ship; the runner refuses to validate if the pre-check fires
lane_precheck_rule.stop_rule: the brief's literal rule: STOP if the candidate's rank correlation with any registry raster exceeds 0.90, or if more than 70% of its dots fall within 3 px of any one registry raster's dots
lane_precheck_rule.known_collision_risk: the DEM/scarp 'dotted ridge' family (h28-dotted-ridge, dotted-h19-5-d1-5 and d2-8, h33-2-b2) is the best-scoring family on the board; if the B-only support reproduces it, the round must stop and log a duplicate instead of shipping

validation_instrument.name: gems52-pooled-hide-v1
validation_instrument.why: it is the repository's pre-registered shared instrument and it was NOT used to choose this arm, so it is an independent check of the screening's prior belief
validation_instrument.folds: gems52.spatial.folds, label-blind quadrants v2, buffer 80 px, whole components hidden, 200 m collar from the VISIBLE catalogue only

promotion_rule: paired 95% CI lower bound of (h98_bonly - random) > 0 on gems52-pooled-hide-v1 AND lane pre-check PASS (not a duplicate) AND canonical uniqueness true; otherwise the round is negative and only the H97 artifact ships

emission_frozen.values: binary {0,1}, zeros outside the organiser domain, no nodata tag

reasoning_requirement: only A-only candidates need written geological reasoning under the brief. This arm emits B-only candidates, so the shipped file carries, for every emitted dot, the surface evidence (curvature magnitude and scale), the potential-field quietness that licenses 'A abstains', and an explicit falsifier (a lidar scarp feature on the segment would mean the fault is surface-mappable and probably already catalogued).
shared_tools_to_reuse: scripts/build_h97_submission.py::build_reasoning (imported, not copied, with the H98 wording)
inputs_provenance: integrity-pinned, not organizer-authenticated (registry/data_manifest.json, 23/23 pins, ALL_VERIFIED=True this session)
